chapters.reason: The paper focuses on absorbing discrete diffusion models, which operate on discrete tokens via masking/absorbing processes, fitting the definition of masked diffusion models.
The paper explicitly unifies absorbing discrete diffusion with any-order autoregressive models (AO-ARMs), demonstrating a hybrid approach between diffusion and autoregressive paradigms.
The paper demonstrates the application and capability of the proposed RADD model in achieving SOTA performance on zero-shot language modeling benchmarks.
